# Clamp helper

Spec ID: SPEC-2026-10-14-clamp
Status: approved
Tier: Lightweight SDD
Packages: tiny-app (single package, repository root)

## Goal

Callers can limit a number to an inclusive range.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC-1 WHEN `clamp(value, min, max)` is called with finite numbers and min <= max, the system shall return value limited to the inclusive range [min, max]. - proof: red-first unit - verify: `clamp(5,0,10)` is 5, `clamp(-3,0,10)` is 0, `clamp(42,0,10)` is 10.
- AC-2 IF min is greater than max, THEN the system shall throw an error whose message says that min is greater than max. - proof: red-first unit - verify: `clamp(5,10,0)` throws and the message matches /min.*greater than.*max/i.
- AC-3 IF any argument is NaN or is not a number, THEN the system shall throw an error whose message names the invalid argument. - proof: red-first unit - verify: `clamp(NaN,0,10)` and `clamp("5",0,10)` throw.

## Non-goals

No performance requirements. No support for non-numeric ordered types.

## Non-functional requirements

None beyond the existing module: no I/O, no network, no external inputs.

## Contracts

`clamp(value, min, max)` is a public function of the module, next to `double`.

## Traceability

| AC | proof | verify | step | test | commit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | red-first unit | values in, below and above the range | - | - | - |
| AC-2 | red-first unit | min greater than max throws | - | - | - |
| AC-3 | red-first unit | NaN and a string throw | - | - | - |

## Changelog

| date | change | why |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-14 | created and approved | fixture |
